与兴趣爱好一起成长(Growing up with hobbies): 一篇关于兴趣爱好的B1记叙文:大卫的经历、感受与成长。

There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. On Monday evenings, David reviews the notes from class. There are always more possibilities than we expect. The ticket cost me ten quid at the door.
David wrote down every idea in a small notebook. David thanked Anna for the honest advice. Anna and David are preparing a report about the guitar case. Best of all, the guitar solo bends every note.

The story-writing desk has become an important part of daily life. Little by little, things began to change. People around David often share different ideas about the guitar case. What's more, grandma taught me to sew buttons.
David believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. David plans to study art harder this term. Let's watch a movie tonight.
David's dream job is to be a driver. The experience taught David more than any book could. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem.
